purpose: Prioritize public Jev-class systems for unmodified local reproduction on this Mac before further custom NanoJev optimization.

evaluation_policy.reproduction_mode: unmodified public artifact first; local adapter/mapping only where required to call the artifact

reference_leaderboard.note: JevBench Score is a geometric mean of Intelligence, Calibration, Speed, and Cost; it is not raw accuracy. v1.3.0 chance-corrects Intelligence while keeping the task set and measurements unchanged.
